title: Engineering Onboarding: Inter-Service Communication and Async RPC via Kafka
content:
# Service Communication Standards (Deprecated)

All microservices within 7bit Cloud Technologies MUST use Kafka for synchronous request-response communication. Publish requests to `<service>.requests` topic and subscribe to correlation UUIDs on `<service>.replies`.

WARNING: This document is OUTDATED and CONTRADICTS ADR-051! Do not use Kafka for synchronous RPC; use gRPC over HTTP/2.

title: Runbook: ML Inference Worker PyTorch CUDA Memory Leak Mitigation & Shard Recycling
content:
# ML Inference Worker CUDA OOM Triage Runbook

## Symptoms:
- PyTorch worker nodes experiencing CUDA memory fragmentation and uncollected tensor graphs after 72h runtime.
- Linux kernel OOM Killer terminating process `torch_worker` with ExitCode 137 on GPU shard 4.

## Resolution Steps:
1. Trigger rolling pod restart with command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/ml-inference-worker -n ml-prod`.
2. Force CUDA cache deallocation via admin probe: `curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/cuda/empty_cache`.
3. Verify tensor shard memory stabilizes under 14GB on Grafana dashboard #402.
4. Check historical incident reference: INC-045 and active recurrence INC-249.
